details:
This update for libmodplug fixes the following issues:

Changes in libmodplug:

- CVE-2026-108577: This issue affects the function abc_add_gchord of the file src/load_abc.cpp of the component ABC Music Format Parser. This manipulation causes resource consumption [bsc#1284977]
- CVE-2026-111270: a heap-based out-of-bounds write in CSoundFile:ReadDSM() in src/load_dsm.cpp because nPat is never checked against MAX_PATTERNS [bsc#1285765]
- CVE-2026-111271: a heap-based out-of-bounds read vulnerability in CSoundFile:ReadAMS2() in src/load_ams.cpp [bsc#1285766]
- CVE-2026-75904: libmodplug through 0.8.9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read in pat_smplooped in src/load_pat.cpp [bsc#1275624]
